skillOrderNotes.interleave: inferred: no source orders passives against actives; R3 put the two 2-source passives first because they are always-on and Assault Stance is named by all four sources

sources.inferred: Row order and the E stack (buffs first, then damage) are the guide's reasoning; no source gives an order. Insignia Explosion sits above the builders because it scales with Insignia stacks (Metabot).

texts.nezekan-plan: Two clusters, from your board: above the centre, Heart Gore with Exploit Weakness 1 branching off its path (11 for both); below the centre, Ambush (7) and Quick Slice (6) share their first two nodes (11 for both), and Exploit Weakness 2 sits 5 past Quick Slice. All five come to 27. Where a node has two routes, take the one with Critical Hit and Attack over HP and Critical Hit resist.

conflicts: Stigma equip order: metabot: Illusive Clone, Swift Contract, Savage Fang, Triniel's Dagger · gamesfuze: Triniel's Dagger (to 10), Illusive Clone (to 20), Savage Fang (1), Swift Contract (1) · skycoach: Triniel's Dagger (to 10 first), Illusive Clone (20 main goal), Swift Contract, Savage Fang (PvE buff at 15). The guide follows Metabot and Skycoach for slots 3–4 (Swift Contract before Savage Fang; GamesFuze reverses it) and GamesFuze + Skycoach for the upgrade targets (src/data/build.js).
notes: Skill order after the core eight (v1 verdict): 2-source for Assault Stance > Impact Hit and Flash Slice > Storm Rampage; rest single; interleave inferred
v1: SP_SKILLS, SP_EXTRA, STIGMA_PLAN, ST_TARGETS, STAT_TIERS, STAT_SRC, RMB_STACK, E_ORDER and the dv milestone items. Up to two credited community builds may join it (owner decision).

stigmaRules.verdict (v1): No 2-source slot-by-level order. GamesFuze+Skycoach agree TD then IC as top two (supports app slots 1-2; these are priority lists, so equip timing is inferred). Slots 3-4: Metabot+Skycoach put Swift Contract before Savage Fang; GamesFuze the reverse. App's SF 32 / SC 37 is the minority order. Same four stigmas in all three sources (2-source+).
Upgrade priority (v1): Triniel's Dagger to 10 and Illusive Clone to 20 (GamesFuze + Skycoach, 2-source). App plan 'all to 5, then slot 1 to 10/15' is Metabot general advice (single).

v1 board notes: Metaroad board page refused (provenance) and GameWith grid is unlabelled; Metabot gives no node coordinates. Path costs unknown; keep 'about 3–5 with its path' only as labelled inference or drop.

Corner totals by board (Metabot full-board totals): Nezekan: Combat Speed +3%, Cooldown Reduction +3%; Zikel: Damage Boost +3%, Damage Tolerance +3%; Vaizel: Critical Damage Boost +3%, Critical Damage Tolerance +3%; Triniel: Multi-hit Chance +4.5%, Multi-hit Resist +4.5% (https://metabot.gg/en/aion-2/daevanion/assassin (full-board totals; the % stats are the corner stats by the +1.5%/corner rule))
